meta.title: Kotone · Voice-to-text for gamers
meta.description: A Windows desktop voice-input tool built for gamers: hold a hotkey, speak, and your words are transcribed on-device in real time — release to send straight into the game chat. 100% local. Your audio never leaves your PC.

hero.sub: Your fingers never leave the keyboard. Say it — don't wait a second.

why.title: Mid-teamfight, your teammate pings you to call out. That's the moment.
why.before: Stop playing → open chat → type → hit enter. You look up — your champion has been standing still for three seconds.
why.after: Hold a hotkey, say “jungler bot side”. Release, and the words are already sent. Your fingers never left the keyboard.
why.tagline: Kotone is communication that never interrupts — input inside the flow of the game, not outside of it.

features.title: Every tool on the streaming desk, sharpened
features.sub: Six pieces, all crafted around one rule: keep your hands on the keyboard.

items.title: Streaming transcription
items.text: Default X-ASR bilingual model with punctuation, words appear as you speak; VAD voice-activity detection ships in the app and is ready at launch.

items.title: Global hotkeys
items.text: Hold-to-talk or tap-to-toggle, bind any key; press again while the hint is showing to start the next line instantly.

items.title: Gaming glossary
items.text: 100 League of Legends terms built in; new entries merge on update, your customizations and deletions never get lost.

items.title: Esports overlay
items.text: Card or capsule styles, fully draggable with saved position, click-through to the game; streaming engines render text live.

items.title: History & replay
items.text: Every recognized line can replay its original audio with a waveform; empty transcriptions never send and leave no trace.

items.title: Local-first privacy
items.text: All models run on your machine, nothing is uploaded; tray resident, auto-update, and one-click admin restart.

modes.title: Four modes for every kind of teamfight
modes.sub: From hold-to-talk to one-shot to never-stopping — one of these is your rhythm.

items.name: Walkie-talkie
items.desc: Hold to talk, release to send.
items.detail: As direct as a radio: hold the hotkey, speak, release — it sends. No hesitation.

items.name: Voice recorder
items.desc: Tap to start, tap to stop.
items.detail: Tap to start recording, tap again when you're done — the whole take sends in one piece.

items.name: One-shot
items.desc: Auto-stops and auto-sends when you're done.
items.detail: A natural pause transcribes and sends on its own — no hotkey needed.

items.name: Solo mode
items.desc: Continuous listening — one phrase, one send, tap again to stop.
items.detail: Tap to start continuous listening. VAD marks each sentence, sends it instantly, never stops. Casting, reading chat, calling shots — one flow. Tap again to stop.

modes.signalTitle: No matter the mode, the signal chain underneath is always the same
modes.signalNote: Everything happens locally — your audio and text never leave your PC.

proof.title: What you see is what you use · real app screenshots

privacy.title: Your audio never leaves your PC.

items.title: Fully on-device
items.text: All models run locally. No network required, no cloud transcription.

items.title: Audio, then gone
items.text: Audio exists only briefly while the hotkey is held, for live transcription. Not stored.

items.title: Open & auditable
items.text: Models, glossary, and privacy policy are all public and inspectable.

cta.title: Say it — send it, in one second.
cta.sub: Free · Open source · v0.1.6 released · Windows 10 / 11 x64
